selection: 21 native bases by round-robin across source-origin x object-count strata, seeded hash order within strata; plus classroom. Representative is unedited first then lexicographic model ID. No detector outcomes consulted.
reason_for_subset: Full 57x17=969 planned mutant slots with all oracle pairs and compiled I2 could exceed 60 minutes. Retained compiled policy benchmarks report about 140 seconds for 827 calls plus compile time; multiple tens of oracle pairs per mutant imply more than 60 minutes sequential. Select bounded 22-room subset before observing new outcomes.
oracle_policy: I1 and retained compiled I2 on all normal agent/object pairs; Gate0 lookup must agree on four-field verdict. These are pure oracle queries, not backend or model probes.
groundtruth: True iff all I1/I2/Gate0 pair verdicts agree and at least one I1 reason is E_UNOWNED,E_AMBIGUOUS_OWNER,E_NO_DECLARED_ACTION,E_ACTION_AMBIGUOUS. False iff agreement and all reasons in those plus null,E_NO_HANDOFF_PATH and none faulty. Otherwise unknown; never force consistency.
mutations: 17 original single operators, original seed derivation, no pairs. no_op/not_applicable/technical failures excluded and reported; refresh_projections preserves documented main-study procedure.
cohort_separation: New Stage B only; no pooling with generated908 or classroom153.
statistical_estimands: Mutant TP/FN/FP/TN among determinate ground truth; sensitivity and specificity Wilson95 plus paired resampling of selected rooms (10000,seed20261015), per-room and per-operator. Undefined bootstrap denominators omitted and count retained.
